title: Second-hand fashion resale
summary: Resell clothing easily, with sustainability appeal.
whyTempting: Huge wardrobes and growing sustainability concern.
whyItFails: Low item value. Handling costs exceed sale prices. Authentication. Luxury requires expensive verification. Crowded market. Many competitors.
whatWouldChange: Brand-run resale programs and AI listing tools.

attempts.outcome: Profitable; profit more than tripled in 2024
attempts.notes: A rare success in the category, built on free selling and buyer fees.

attempts.outcome: Bought by Etsy, then sold to eBay for $1.2 billion

attempts.notes: Went public in 2021 at over $3 billion; sold for $1.2 billion two years later.

reasons.detail: Low item value: Handling costs exceed sale prices.
